description: Defines the WebBridge class and related nested classes, enums, and types for a plugin in the WPEFramework. Includes interface implementations, internal data structures, and method declarations for plugin lifecycle, WebSocket handling, and message dispatching.

classes.name: WebBridge
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, dispatcher, and WebSocket interfaces, managing plugin lifecycle, message handling, and observer management.

classes.name: WebBridge::Observer
classes.description: Represents an observer with an ID and designator, supporting comparison operators.

classes.name: WebBridge::Request
classes.description: Represents a request with channel ID, sequence ID, and timestamp.

classes.name: WebBridge::Cleaner
classes.description: A worker pool job class responsible for cleanup operations within WebBridge.

classes.name: WebBridge::Config
classes.description: Configuration class for WebBridge, including timeout and bind address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the service.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages, overloaded for string identifier and numeric ID.

methods.name: HasMethodSupport
methods.description: Checks if a method is supported in a given version map.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination state and handler based on a designator string.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers an observer for an event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an observer from an event.
